name: wiremee
title: Banking and beyond, in one app
description: A fintech building banking and cross-border payments in one app, for people and businesses across Africa.
summary: Money and more in one app: banking and cross-border payments for Africa.
overview: wiremee is building a cross-border payment platform to accelerate financial inclusion in Africa. Its app brings banking, payments and more into one place for individuals, businesses and a younger generation of users.
ZIIV worked with the wiremee team on the project. wiremee is in pre-launch, with a waitlist open on its website.

scope.name: Personal
scope.text: Mobile banking, freelancer accounts, investments and international transfers.

scope.name: Business
scope.text: Cross-border and bulk payments, invoicing and currency exchange.

scope.name: GenZ
scope.text: Savings, group contributions and peer-to-peer transfers.

scope.name: Security
scope.text: Tiered identity verification and biometric login.

standing: In pre-launch. The waitlist is open at wiremee.com.
ownership: A client project. wiremee belongs to WIREMEE LTD.
